Accuracy of observation sensors in capturing work patterns
Reliability of the 'Brain' in detecting employee intent, business value, and drift
Effectiveness of the Agent Factory in generating and deploying high-ROI AI agents

core_insight.why_different: Narma integrates observation, intelligence, and execution into a single, continuous system for AI automation, whereas existing solutions often address only parts of this process.
core_insight.source_excerpt: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a "Continuous AI lift."
core_insight.if_wrong: If enterprises cannot effectively observe, analyze, and automate based on work patterns, then Narma will not be able to deliver continuous AI lift or demonstrate reliable ROI.

raw.product_description: Narma is designed with a three-layered architecture. Layer 1, Observe, uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2, the Intelligence Layer or "Brain," detects employee intent, the business value of tasks, and "drift" where work deviates from intended flows. Layer 3, the Execution Layer or "Agent Factory," automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities, incorporating built-in approval gates. This integrated system aims to ensure "Continuous AI lift" within AI-first companies.
raw.thesis: Narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to address the challenges of deploying AI automation at scale. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an observation layer that captures work patterns, an intelligence layer that identifies employee intent and business value, and an execution layer that automatically generates and deploys AI agents. This system aims to provide "Continuous AI lift" by continuously optimizing AI automation within enterprises. The venture targets AI-first companies struggling with the lack of telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurement, and operational drift. The founder is building a growth-oriented startup, as indicated by the focus on "AI at scale" and continuous optimization. The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the description outlining the conceptual architecture and vision rather than a built product or user traction. The venture aims to complement existing AI solutions by providing the intelligence and execution layer to manage and optimize their deployment, rather than replacing them. This means Narma would sit "above" existing AI tools, making them more effective and measurable.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited about building a single, continuous system that can observe, decide, and auto-build AI agents to ensure "Continuous AI lift" for AI-first companies.

bottleneck.why_it_blocks: The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the core three-layered architecture and its components (sensors, brain, agent factory) yet to be built or proven.
bottleneck.relaxed_by: Developing a functional prototype or MVP of the integrated system.
bottleneck.current_blocker: Building out the core technology layers (Observe, Intelligence, Execution)
